record.question: In a manual wet-processing darkroom, if the developer solution temperature is too high, what is the likely effect on the final radiograph?
options: The image will be underexposed (too light).
The image will have higher contrast.
The image will be overexposed (too dark) and have increased fog.
The image will have less graininess.
record.explanation: Answer C: The image will be overexposed (too dark) and have increased fog.. Overheated developer accelerates development, producing excessive density and often fog. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html.
